question: Who/What are the natural hosts of Nipah virus?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Fruit bats**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The natural hosts of the Nipah virus are fruit bats of the Pteropodidae family.
 
• They carry the virus without showing any symptoms and can transmit it to other animals, including pigs and humans.
 
• While the virus can infect many animals, including pigs, goats, and other mammals, these animals are not the natural hosts.
 
• They become infected through contact with infected bat droppings, saliva, or urine.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The other options - birds, pigs, and goats - are not the natural hosts of the Nipah virus.
 
• While they can become infected and transmit the virus, they are not the primary reservoir.
 
 
• **Birds:** Birds are not known to be susceptible to the Nipah virus.
 
• **Pigs:** Pigs can become infected with the Nipah virus, especially through contact with contaminated food or water. However, they are not the natural hosts and can only transmit the virus to other animals or humans.
 
• **Goats:** Goats can also become infected with the Nipah virus, but they are not the natural hosts. They can transmit the virus to other animals or humans.
